title: Panel Templates & Page Layout Grammar
objective: Define deterministic page/panel layout grammar over sealed SAA-01 project/page/panel identities, including common and custom reusable panel grids, frame-splitting operations, gutters, margins, bleed/safe-area rules and freeform panel layouts, without implementing the SAA-03 interactive composition canvas.
acceptance: Common panel-grid templates are typed, versioned and deterministic.
Margins, gutters, bleed and safe-area values are explicit schema state with validated bounds.
Freeform panel geometry is representable without mutating SAA-01 project/page/panel identity.
Template application yields deterministic panel-layout state and stable serialization.
Template-wide edits may update compatible panel border/gutter/layout parameters consistently without silently changing authored content or reading order.
A page/frame may be deterministically split by authored divider operations, with explicit frame-border and gutter values and stable resulting panel identity.
Frame layouts can be created from reusable presets or authored/saved as custom templates without copying source assets into template state.
Reading order is explicit and independent from incidental rendering coordinates.
Layout grammar remains presentation/authoring state and does not mutate Scene, Character, ARI or other canonical owner truth.
Keyboard/textual equivalents can represent blocking layout operations for later UI consumption.
Provider-off local operation is supported; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-03 interactive composition behavior and later SAA tranches remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-01.1 remains sealed and owns project/page/panel/layer schema identity.
SAA-02 defines layout grammar only; drag/resize/crop/z-order interaction belongs to SAA-03.
ARI and source-domain owners remain authoritative.
No export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
Competitor-inspired template/frame capabilities are feature-level clean-room requirements only; no proprietary template files or private formats are consumed.
next_action: Establish causal RED for common/custom templates, frame-splitting, margin/gutter/bleed/safe-area geometry, freeform layouts, explicit reading order and deterministic serialization; then implement only SAA-02. SAA-03+ remain unauthorized.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SAA-02 after verified SAA-01 closeout and canonical competitive-capability expansion.
